## History

Jordan went to [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston) one winter for work, where he fell in love with [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) Murray. After receiving a farm from Mr. Gray, he built a small house on it where he and [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) lived together for four years. Following Hester's death, Jordan sold the farm and returned to [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston), where he died roughly ten years later before being brought home to be buried beside her.

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P51](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0051), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P54](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0054)_
